title: Black Monday Stock Market Crash
description: Global stock markets crashed sharply on Black Monday, one of the largest one-day percentage declines in history.

title: Mars Pathfinder Lands on Mars
description: NASA's Mars Pathfinder mission successfully landed and deployed the Sojourner rover on the Martian surface.

title: Droupadi Murmu Becomes President of India
description: Droupadi Murmu was sworn in as President of India, the first from a tribal community to hold the office.

title: Abolition of Slavery in the British Empire
description: The Slavery Abolition Act came into force across most of the British Empire, freeing enslaved people.

title: Krakatoa Volcanic Eruption
description: The volcanic island of Krakatoa erupted catastrophically, producing one of the loudest explosions in recorded history.

title: Opening of the Hagia Sophia
description: Emperor Justinian I dedicated the Hagia Sophia in Constantinople, a landmark of Byzantine architecture.

title: Release of Pyaasa
description: Guru Dutt's Pyaasa premiered, later regarded as one of the greatest Hindi films ever made.

title: Standard Oil Trust Formed
description: John D. Rockefeller formed the Standard Oil Trust, consolidating control over the American oil industry.

title: Space Shuttle Columbia Disaster
description: The Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated during re-entry, killing all seven astronauts on board.

title: Publication of Anne Frank's Diary
description: The diary of Anne Frank was first published in the Netherlands, later becoming one of the most-read books about the Holocaust.

title: Launch of Windows 95 Operating System
description: Microsoft released Windows 95, a major operating system update that popularized the Start menu.

title: First American in Orbit
description: Astronaut John Glenn became the first American to orbit the Earth, aboard Friendship 7.

title: Formation of the Modern Olympic Movement
description: Pierre de Coubertin founded the International Olympic Committee, reviving the Olympic Games for the modern era.

title: Usain Bolt Wins Triple-Triple at Rio Olympics
description: Usain Bolt completed his third consecutive Olympic sweep of the 100m, 200m, and relay events.

title: Abolition of Slavery in the United States
description: The Thirteenth Amendment to the US Constitution was ratified, formally abolishing slavery.

title: Pratibha Patil Becomes First Woman President of India
description: Pratibha Patil was sworn in as India's first female president.

title: Founding of Amazon Web Services
description: Amazon launched its cloud computing division, AWS, transforming how businesses host digital infrastructure.

title: India Successfully Hosts Commonwealth Games
description: New Delhi hosted the Commonwealth Games, India's largest multi-sport event at the time.

title: Mount St Helens Erupts
description: Mount St. Helens erupted violently in Washington state, causing widespread destruction and reshaping the landscape.

title: Bachendri Pal Becomes First Indian Woman to Summit Everest
description: Mountaineer Bachendri Pal became the first Indian woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: First MTV Video Music Awards Held
description: MTV held its first Video Music Awards ceremony, honoring achievement in music videos.

title: Opening of the Channel Tunnel
description: The Channel Tunnel connecting England and France beneath the sea officially opened to traffic.

title: Launch of PlayStation Console
description: Sony released the original PlayStation console in Japan, transforming the video game industry.
